TORQUE CONVERTER CLUTCH
AND DRIVE PLATE
INSPECTION
1. INSPECT ONE-WAY CLUTCH
(a) Install SST into the inner race of the one----way clutch.
SST 09350--32014 (09351-3201 O)
(b) Install SST so that it flts in the notch of the converter hub
and outer race of the one-way clutch.
SST 09350-32014 (09351-32020)
(c) With the torque converter clutch setting up on its side,
check that the clutch locks when turned counterclock­
wise, and rotates smoothly clockwise.
If necessary, clean the converter and retest the clutch. Lock
Replace the converter clutch if the clutch still fails the test. Free ./!JJ
AT3306
2. MEASURE DRIVE PLATE RUNOUT AND INSPECT
RING GEAR
(a) Set up a dial indicator and measure the drive plate runout.
(b} Check the damage of the ring gear.
Maximum runout: 0.20 mm (0.0079 In.)
If the runout is not within the specification or ring gear is dam­
aged, rep!ace the drive plate.
Torque: 78 N,m (800 kgf-cm, 58 tt-lbf)
3. MEASURE TORQUE CONVERTER CLUTCH SLEEVE
RUNOUT
Temporarily mount the torque converter clutch on the drive
plate. Set a dia! indicator and measure the torque converter
clutch sleeve runout.
Maximum runout: 0,30 mm (0.0118 in.)
lf the runout is not within the specification, try to correct by reori­
enting the installation of the converter.
